### Purpose

Enforce citation presence on normative claims, producer/source_trace integrity, and supports_concern direction via salient-token overlap; annotate failures only. Deterministic citation-hygiene audit for candidates/findings.

### Context

- **Domain:** ADR-0010 companion to AG-HALLUCINATION-CHECK; soft unverifiable-relation flags never hard-fail. Runs identically with AI OFF for baseline audits.
- **Jurisdiction:** Citation adequacy judged within the selected pack's rules.
- **Project:** Operates after hallucination check in the same batch stage.

### Contract

- **Checks:** citation presence on normative claims; producer/source_trace enforcement; use-direction consistency (supports_concern direction) via salient-token overlap.
- **Failure mode:** annotate-and-continue — failures annotate auto-flagged, never drop; the audit is never blocked.

### Verification

- ADR-0010 behavior tests cover missing-citation, producer/source_trace and use-direction flags with AI off and on.
